# Health & Hygiene Report 0.1.6

## Health & Hygiene Inspection

- Complete inspection scoring inside the application.
- Twelve controlled sections and 181 controlled inspection items.
- Blank, 0, 1, 2, 3, and NA scoring with live section subtotals and a weighted Final Score.
- Previous-audit score and comment prefill.
- Improved inspection navigation and autosave behavior.

## Excel and Word

- Improved Excel evidence-photo layout.
- Balanced fit for a single photo and equal true-cover tiles for two photos.
- Improved Word export naming based on the Inspection Date.

## Updates

- Automatic in-app notification when a newer signed stable version is available.
